name: What documentation should I keep during a historic conservation project?

mainEntity.name: What documentation should I keep during a historic conservation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Keeping thorough records—existing-condition photos, measured drawings, product data, and before-and-after images—helps track work and support future maintenance or incentives. This documentation can also be valuable if you later seek designation, tax credits, or insurance claims.
